title: Glacier Gardens Rainforest Adventure
specs: Flower Towers made from storm-felled trees with vibrant flower baskets
Views of Mendenhall Valley and Chilkat Mountains from 580 feet elevation
Wildlife sightings including bald eagles, hummingbirds, songbirds, and occasional black bears
Live camera feed of an active bald eagle nest inside visitor center
Tour suitable for all ages and abilities
Atrium venue available for private events and weddings, capacity up to 120 guests
includes: Access to visitor center, gift shop, café, and lower garden area
gap: Exact cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests take a 60-90 minute guided tour in covered golf carts through 50 acres of Tongass National Forest, seeing native plants, wildlife, and panoramic views. The tour includes stops to learn about the ecology and history of the area. After the tour, guests can explore the lower garden area on foot, visit the visitor center, gift shop, and café.
extraNote: No reservations required for groups under 10; walk-in and join next available tour · Tours run roughly every hour from 9:15 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. · Visitor Center at 7600 Glacier Highway, Juneau, AK · May 1 through September 30
